stories.name: Teacher-Student Story
stories.description: One partner educates or guides the other
stories.descriptionZh: 一方教導或引導另一方

items.en: I like a relationship in which my partner relies on me to teach him or her important new information and skills.
items.zh: 我喜歡一段關係，讓伴侶依賴我來教他/她重要的新知識和技能。

items.en: I like a relationship in which I teach my partner many things.
items.zh: 我喜歡一段我能教伴侶很多事情的關係。

items.en: I like a relationship in which my partner grows through what he or she learns from me.
items.zh: 我喜歡一段關係，讓伴侶能透過從我這裡學到的東西而成長。

items.en: I believe it is important for my partner to let me teach him or her things.
items.zh: 我認為讓伴侶願意讓我教他/她事情是很重要的。

items.en: I enjoy when my partner teaches me new things.
items.zh: 我喜歡伴侶教我新事物。

items.en: I like a relationship in which my partner is much more knowledgeable than I am.
items.zh: 我喜歡一段伴侶比我更有學識的關係。

items.en: I look up to my partner as a role model for my own learning.
items.zh: 我把伴侶當作我學習的榜樣來仰望。

items.en: I learn a great deal from my partner.
items.zh: 我從伴侶那裡學到很多。

stories.name: Sacrifice Story
stories.description: Love means sacrificing for your partner

items.en: I believe that sacrifice is an integral part of true love.
items.zh: 我相信犧牲是真愛不可或缺的一部分。

items.en: I believe the essence of love should be the willingness to sacrifice for the other.
items.zh: 我相信愛的本質應該是願意為對方犧牲。

items.en: I would rather suffer myself than have my partner suffer.
items.zh: 我寧願自己受苦也不願讓伴侶受苦。

items.en: I believe sacrifice is an integral part of lasting love.
items.zh: 我相信犧牲是持久愛情不可或缺的一部分。

items.en: I believe my partner should be willing to sacrifice anything for me.
items.zh: 我認為伴侶應該願意為我犧牲一切。

items.en: I believe my partner should be willing to sacrifice his or her own needs for my own.
items.zh: 我認為伴侶應該願意為了我的需求而犧牲自己的需求。

items.en: I like my partner to be willing to do anything to make me happy.
items.zh: 我喜歡伴侶願意做任何事來讓我快樂。

items.en: I believe it is extremely important that my partner puts my needs first.
items.zh: 我認為伴侶把我的需求放在第一位是極其重要的。

stories.name: Government Story
stories.descriptionZh: 由權力動態結構化的關係

items.en: I believe that in a relationship there should be one partner who makes most of the decisions.
items.zh: 我認為在關係中應該有一個人做大部分的決定。

items.en: I believe partners in a relationship should not be equal, and one should have more control than the other.
items.zh: 我認為關係中的伴侶不應該平等，一方應該比另一方有更多控制權。

items.en: I think there should be one dominating partner who is the one who makes the decisions in the relationship.
items.zh: 我認為應該有一個主導的伴侶來做關係中的決定。

items.en: I believe one of the two partners should be in control of the relationship.
items.zh: 我認為兩人中應該有一個人控制這段關係。

items.en: I believe that both partners in a relationship should share equally in decision making.
items.zh: 我相信關係中的雙方應該平等地分擔決策。

items.en: I believe that it is important for both partners to have equal power in a relationship.
items.zh: 我認為雙方在關係中擁有平等的權力是很重要的。

items.en: I believe everything in a relationship should be negotiated equally between both partners.
items.zh: 我相信關係中的一切都應該由雙方平等協商。

items.en: I believe that partners in a relationship should be absolutely equal in making decisions.
items.zh: 我認為關係中的伴侶在做決定時應該絕對平等。

items.en: I believe it is very important to keep track of everything that my partner is doing.
items.zh: 我認為追蹤伴侶正在做的一切是非常重要的。

items.en: I like to know what my partner is up to at all times.
items.zh: 我喜歡隨時知道伴侶在做什麼。

items.en: I believe it is important to monitor my partner's activities closely.
items.zh: 我認為密切監控伴侶的活動是重要的。

items.en: I like always to know where my partner is and what my partner is doing.
items.zh: 我喜歡總是知道伴侶在哪裡、在做什麼。

items.en: I believe it is all right for my partner to closely watch everything I do.
items.zh: 我認為伴侶密切關注我做的一切是可以的。

items.en: I don't mind if my partner wants to know everything about my activities.
items.zh: 如果伴侶想知道我活動的一切，我不介意。

items.en: I believe it is all right for my partner to check up on me often.
items.zh: 我認為伴侶經常查看我的情況是可以的。

items.en: I don't mind being watched by my partner.
items.zh: 我不介意被伴侶監視。

items.en: I think it is exciting to have degrading sexual experiences with my partner.
items.zh: 我認為與伴侶有貶低性的性經驗是令人興奮的。

items.en: It is important to have degrading sex in a relationship.
items.zh: 在關係中有貶低性的性行為是重要的。

items.en: I like to use obscene terms when I am having sex with my partner.
items.zh: 我喜歡在與伴侶發生性行為時使用猥褻的詞語。

items.en: I sometimes enjoy degrading my partner sexually.
items.zh: 我有時喜歡在性方面貶低我的伴侶。

items.en: I sometimes enjoy being degraded sexually.
items.zh: 我有時喜歡在性方面被貶低。

items.en: I believe kinky sex is an exciting part of relationships.
items.zh: 我相信另類的性是關係中令人興奮的一部分。

items.en: I like relationships in which partners have really dirty sex with each other.
items.zh: 我喜歡伴侶之間有真正骯髒性行為的關係。

items.en: I often enjoy having dirty sex with my partner.
items.zh: 我經常享受與伴侶的骯髒性行為。

items.en: I often find myself trying to scare my partner.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己試圖嚇唬伴侶。

items.en: I sometimes enjoy seeing my partner a little afraid of me.
items.zh: 我有時喜歡看到伴侶有點怕我。

items.en: I enjoy terrorizing my partner a little.
items.zh: 我喜歡稍微恐嚇我的伴侶。

items.en: I find it exciting when I have a partner a little scared of me.
items.zh: 當伴侶有點怕我時，我覺得很興奮。

items.en: I sometimes find it exciting to feel a little terrified of my partner.
items.zh: 我有時發現對伴侶感到有點恐懼是令人興奮的。

items.en: I sometimes find it exciting for my partner to terrorize me.
items.zh: 我有時發現被伴侶恐嚇是令人興奮的。

items.en: I find it exciting to be with a somewhat dangerous partner.
items.zh: 我發現與一個有點危險的伴侶在一起是令人興奮的。

items.en: I find it exciting to be a little afraid of my partner.
items.zh: 我發現對伴侶有點害怕是令人興奮的。

stories.name: Science Fiction Story
stories.description: Attracted to unusual or different partners
stories.descriptionZh: 被不尋常或不同的伴侶吸引

items.en: I often find myself attracted to partners who seem almost from a different world.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己被看起來幾乎來自不同世界的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I often find myself attracted to unusual partners.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己被不尋常的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I often find myself attracted to partners who are totally different from what I am accustomed to.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己被與我習慣的完全不同的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I am attracted to partners who seem totally out of the ordinary.
items.zh: 我被看起來完全不平凡的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I am attracted to partners from very different backgrounds.
items.zh: 我被來自非常不同背景的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I often find myself attracted to partners who have a background that is different from my own.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己被有著與我不同背景的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I am often attracted to partners who are somehow very different from me.
items.zh: 我經常被在某方面與我非常不同的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I often find myself attracted to partners who are strange or unusual.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己被奇怪或不尋常的伴侶吸引。

stories.name: Collection Story
stories.description: Partner as an item in a collection
stories.descriptionZh: 伴侶作為收藏品中的一件物品

items.en: I like a partner who fits into my overall life the way an item fits into a collection.
items.zh: 我喜歡一個能融入我整體生活的伴侶，就像一件物品融入收藏一樣。

items.en: I like to date different partners concurrently in order to compare them.
items.zh: 我喜歡同時約會不同的伴侶以便比較他們。

items.en: I like to date different partners sequentially in order to compare them.
items.zh: 我喜歡依序約會不同的伴侶以便比較他們。

items.en: I often compare how my current partner stacks up to partners I have dated in the past.
items.zh: 我經常比較我現在的伴侶與過去約會過的伴侶。

items.en: I carefully evaluate my partner in terms of the standards I have for relationships.
items.zh: 我根據我對關係的標準仔細評估我的伴侶。

items.en: I like a partner who is like a trophy I have won in life.
items.zh: 我喜歡一個像是我在生活中贏得的獎盃一樣的伴侶。

items.en: I tend to treat my partner as an extension of my self-image.
items.zh: 我傾向於把伴侶當作我自我形象的延伸。

items.en: I like a partner who is admired by others.
items.zh: 我喜歡一個被他人欽佩的伴侶。

items.en: Physical attractiveness is the most important factor in choosing a potential partner.
items.zh: 外表吸引力是選擇潛在伴侶時最重要的因素。

items.en: I strongly believe that physical attractiveness is one of the most important determinants of having a good relationship.
items.zh: 我堅信外表吸引力是擁有良好關係最重要的決定因素之一。

items.en: What I find most attractive about potential partners is their physical appearance.
items.zh: 我認為潛在伴侶最吸引人的是他們的外表。

items.en: I believe physical looks should be an important part of a relationship.
items.zh: 我相信外表應該是關係中的重要部分。

items.en: It is very important for me to choose a partner that I find physically attractive.
items.zh: 選擇一個我覺得外表有吸引力的伴侶對我來說非常重要。

items.en: I believe relationships that do not include a physically attractive partner are doomed to failure.
items.zh: 我相信不包含外表有吸引力的伴侶的關係注定會失敗。

items.en: I believe it is all right to judge a partner by his or her physical appearance.
items.zh: 我認為根據伴侶的外表來評判他/她是可以的。

items.en: I strongly believe that looks are what counts most in choosing a partner.
items.zh: 我堅信選擇伴侶時外表是最重要的。

stories.name: House and Home Story
stories.description: Home is the center of the relationship

items.en: I think of our house (or apartment) as a castle within which we live.
items.zh: 我把我們的房子（或公寓）想成我們居住的城堡。

items.en: I feel the center of my life is my home.
items.zh: 我覺得我生活的中心是我的家。

items.en: I see the house (or apartment) as the most important part of my relationship.
items.zh: 我認為房子（或公寓）是我關係中最重要的部分。

items.en: I believe building a home together is an important part of a relationship.
items.zh: 我相信一起建立一個家是關係中的重要部分。

items.en: I believe the house (or apartment) should be the center of the relationship.
items.zh: 我認為房子（或公寓）應該是關係的中心。

items.en: I strongly prefer staying home with my partner to going out with other friends or alone.
items.zh: 我強烈偏好與伴侶待在家裡，而不是和其他朋友出去或獨自外出。

items.en: I feel my home is my castle.
items.zh: 我覺得我的家就是我的城堡。

items.en: Spending time at home with my partner is more important than other activities.
items.zh: 與伴侶在家共度時光比其他活動更重要。

stories.name: Recovery Story
stories.description: Healing from past wounds through love
stories.descriptionZh: 透過愛療癒過去的創傷

items.en: I believe that my partner must help me recover from painful relationships.
items.zh: 我相信伴侶必須幫助我從痛苦的關係中恢復。

items.en: I need a partner who will help me recover from a difficult past.
items.zh: 我需要一個能幫助我從艱難過去中恢復的伴侶。

items.en: I expect my partner to take care of me, because of the difficult life I have had.
items.zh: 我期望伴侶照顧我，因為我曾經歷艱難的生活。

items.en: My partner must be understanding of my previous pain.
items.zh: 我的伴侶必須理解我以前的痛苦。

items.en: I am often attracted to partners who have had particularly difficult pasts.
items.zh: 我經常被有特別艱難過去的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I am often attracted to partners who need help recovering from a past relationship.
items.zh: 我經常被需要幫助從過去關係中恢復的伴侶吸引。

items.en: I often find myself taking care of a partner who is still recovering from their past.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己在照顧一個仍在從過去中恢復的伴侶。

items.en: I am often attracted to people who need to be rescued from a difficult past.
items.zh: 我經常被需要從艱難過去中被拯救的人吸引。

stories.name: Religion Story
stories.description: Partner as object of worship or vice versa
stories.descriptionZh: 伴侶作為崇拜對象或反之

items.en: I tend to look up to my partner as I would look up to a higher power.
items.zh: 我傾向於仰望我的伴侶，就像仰望更高的力量一樣。

items.en: I expect my partner to be like a role model for me.
items.zh: 我期望伴侶成為我的榜樣。

items.en: I tend to worship my partner.
items.zh: 我傾向於崇拜我的伴侶。

items.en: I tend to treat my partner as almost a godlike figure.
items.zh: 我傾向於把伴侶當作幾乎像神一樣的人物。

items.en: I look up to my partner as being close to perfection.
items.zh: 我仰望伴侶，覺得他/她接近完美。

items.en: I believe my partner is a near-perfect human being.
items.zh: 我相信我的伴侶是一個近乎完美的人。

items.en: I expect my partner to be the one to lead me through life.
items.zh: 我期望伴侶成為引領我走過人生的人。

items.en: I admire my partner as I would admire a very powerful figure.
items.zh: 我欽佩我的伴侶，就像欽佩一個非常有權勢的人物一樣。

items.en: I expect my partner to be totally devoted to me.
items.zh: 我期望伴侶完全忠於我。

items.en: I expect to be treated very specially by my partner.
items.zh: 我期望被伴侶非常特別地對待。

items.en: I expect my partner to look up to me.
items.zh: 我期望伴侶仰望我。

items.en: I expect my partner to treat me as a very important figure in his or her life.
items.zh: 我期望伴侶把我當作他/她生命中非常重要的人物。

items.en: I believe my partner should be willing to put me on a pedestal.
items.zh: 我認為伴侶應該願意把我捧上神壇。

items.en: I believe that my partner should treat me as a very special person.
items.zh: 我認為伴侶應該把我當作非常特別的人對待。

items.en: I expect my partner to admire me very highly.
items.zh: 我期望伴侶非常欽佩我。

items.en: I expect my partner to look up to me as he or she would look up to a higher power.
items.zh: 我期望伴侶仰望我，就像仰望更高的力量一樣。

stories.name: Game Story
stories.description: Love as a game to be played
stories.descriptionZh: 愛情作為一場要玩的遊戲

items.en: I believe love is a game and the partner I choose is my playing partner.
items.zh: 我相信愛情是一場遊戲，我選擇的伴侶是我的遊戲夥伴。

items.en: I like to play games with my partner.
items.zh: 我喜歡和伴侶玩遊戲。

items.en: I believe in playing love games with my partner.
items.zh: 我相信與伴侶玩愛情遊戲。

items.en: I believe games are an important part of a relationship.
items.zh: 我相信遊戲是關係中的重要部分。

items.en: I believe love is largely a game to be played.
items.zh: 我相信愛情在很大程度上是一場要玩的遊戲。

items.en: I believe that relationships are meant to be fun games.
items.zh: 我相信關係就是要成為有趣的遊戲。

items.en: I believe that love can be compared to a game in which both partners participate.
items.zh: 我相信愛情可以比作一場雙方都參與的遊戲。

items.en: I believe love is like a game; if you play it right, you win.
items.zh: 我相信愛情就像遊戲；如果你玩得對，你就贏了。

stories.name: Travel Story
stories.descriptionZh: 愛情作為令人興奮的旅程

items.en: I believe love is a journey, requiring constant exploration.
items.zh: 我相信愛情是一段旅程，需要不斷探索。

items.en: I believe a relationship should be an adventure.
items.zh: 我相信關係應該是一場冒險。

items.en: I believe relationships are journeys of self and mutual discovery.
items.zh: 我相信關係是自我和相互發現的旅程。

items.en: I believe relationships are an adventure that never ends.
items.zh: 我相信關係是永無止境的冒險。

items.en: I believe relationships should be exciting journeys full of new experiences.
items.zh: 我相信關係應該是充滿新體驗的令人興奮的旅程。

items.en: I believe exploring life together with my partner is the most exciting part of a relationship.
items.zh: 我相信與伴侶一起探索生活是關係中最令人興奮的部分。

items.en: I believe relationships are mostly exciting adventures.
items.zh: 我相信關係大多是令人興奮的冒險。

items.en: I believe part of what makes a relationship exciting is discovering new things about each other.
items.zh: 我相信關係令人興奮的一部分是發現彼此的新事物。

items.en: I believe relationships have to be made to fit two people.
items.zh: 我相信關係必須被打造來適合兩個人。

items.en: I believe that in a relationship, both partners must fit together perfectly.
items.zh: 我相信在關係中，雙方必須完美契合。

items.en: I believe both partners in a relationship must fit together like pieces of a puzzle.
items.zh: 我相信關係中的雙方必須像拼圖一樣契合在一起。

items.en: I believe a relationship must be carefully molded to fit the partners.
items.zh: 我相信關係必須被仔細塑造以適合伴侶。

items.en: I believe relationships must be carefully tailored to work well.
items.zh: 我相信關係必須被仔細量身定做才能運作良好。

items.en: I believe relationships should be carefully constructed like a piece of fabric.
items.zh: 我相信關係應該像一塊布料一樣被仔細構建。

items.en: I believe that relationship skills are like sewing skills: Both need to be carefully learned.
items.zh: 我相信關係技能就像縫紉技能：都需要仔細學習。

items.en: I believe relationships should be carefully put together to fit the partners.
items.zh: 我相信關係應該被仔細組合以適合伴侶。

items.en: I believe that, like a garden, a relationship needs to be continually nurtured.
items.zh: 我相信，就像花園一樣，關係需要持續培育。

items.en: I believe love, like plants in a garden, needs to be cared for on a regular basis.
items.zh: 我相信愛情，就像花園裡的植物，需要定期照顧。

items.en: I believe that relationships, like gardens, need constant attention to keep them thriving.
items.zh: 我相信關係，就像花園，需要持續關注才能保持繁榮。

items.en: I believe relationships need to be carefully cultivated.
items.zh: 我相信關係需要被仔細培養。

items.en: I believe good relationships, like good gardens, require constant care.
items.zh: 我相信好的關係，就像好的花園，需要持續照顧。

items.en: I believe a relationship grows stronger with careful attention.
items.zh: 我相信關係會隨著細心關注而變得更強。

items.en: I believe relationships must be nurtured like growing plants.
items.zh: 我相信關係必須像生長的植物一樣被培育。

items.en: I believe that without careful nurturing, a relationship will wither and die.
items.zh: 我相信沒有細心培育，關係會枯萎和死亡。

stories.name: Business Story
stories.descriptionZh: 關係作為商業夥伴關係

items.en: I believe relationships are like business partnerships.
items.zh: 我相信關係就像商業夥伴關係。

items.en: I believe relationships are most successful when both partners contribute equally.
items.zh: 我相信當雙方平等貢獻時，關係最成功。

items.en: I believe that partners in a relationship should keep track of what each person contributes.
items.zh: 我相信關係中的伴侶應該追蹤每個人的貢獻。

items.en: I believe a relationship is like a partnership in which both partners invest.
items.zh: 我相信關係就像雙方都投資的合夥關係。

items.en: I believe a relationship should be run like a business.
items.zh: 我相信關係應該像企業一樣經營。

items.en: I believe relationships work best when they are like business partnerships.
items.zh: 我相信當關係像商業夥伴關係時效果最好。

items.en: I believe what matters most in relationships is who puts in the most and gets back the most.
items.zh: 我相信關係中最重要的是誰投入最多並得到最多回報。

items.en: I believe relationships are best when they are run like efficient businesses.
items.zh: 我相信當關係像高效企業一樣運作時是最好的。

stories.name: Addiction Story
stories.description: Dependent on partner like an addiction

items.en: I need my partner like an addict needs a drug.
items.zh: 我需要我的伴侶，就像成癮者需要藥物一樣。

items.en: I find it hard to function without my partner being around.
items.zh: 沒有伴侶在身邊，我很難正常運作。

items.en: I find I can barely get through the day if my partner isn't there for me.
items.zh: 如果伴侶不在我身邊，我發現我幾乎無法度過這一天。

items.en: I find I am dependent on my partner for most things.
items.zh: 我發現我在大多數事情上都依賴伴侶。

items.en: I feel I cannot live without my partner.
items.zh: 我覺得沒有伴侶我無法生活。

items.en: I find that I am overly dependent on my partner in my relationship.
items.zh: 我發現在我們的關係中，我過度依賴伴侶。

items.en: Without my partner I feel empty.
items.zh: 沒有伴侶，我感到空虛。

items.en: I would feel completely lost without my partner.
items.zh: 沒有伴侶，我會感到完全迷失。

items.en: I sometimes expect my partner to be like my idea of a perfect mate.
items.zh: 我有時期望伴侶像我心目中的完美伴侶。

items.en: I dream of finding the perfect partner for myself.
items.zh: 我夢想為自己找到完美的伴侶。

items.en: I often daydream about the perfect relationship.
items.zh: 我經常幻想完美的關係。

items.en: I often find myself waiting for the perfect partner to come along.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己在等待完美的伴侶出現。

items.en: I believe that someday I will find the perfect partner.
items.zh: 我相信總有一天我會找到完美的伴侶。

items.en: I often fantasize about what the perfect relationship would be like.
items.zh: 我經常幻想完美的關係會是什麼樣子。

items.en: I dream about finding my one true love.
items.zh: 我夢想找到我唯一的真愛。

items.en: I often imagine what the perfect relationship would be like.
items.zh: 我經常想像完美的關係會是什麼樣子。

items.en: I believe it is important to maintain records of a relationship.
items.zh: 我相信保持關係的記錄是重要的。

items.en: I enjoy keeping photos, videos, or other souvenirs of my relationship.
items.zh: 我喜歡保留關係的照片、影片或其他紀念品。

items.en: I believe it is important to know and remember the important dates in a relationship.
items.zh: 我相信知道和記住關係中的重要日期是重要的。

items.en: I enjoy looking at pictures and other souvenirs of my relationship.
items.zh: 我喜歡看關係的照片和其他紀念品。

items.en: I believe anniversaries and other important dates should always be remembered.
items.zh: 我相信週年紀念日和其他重要日期應該永遠被記住。

items.en: I like to keep a record of the important events in my relationship.
items.zh: 我喜歡記錄關係中的重要事件。

items.en: I believe it is important to remember the history of a relationship.
items.zh: 我相信記住關係的歷史是重要的。

items.en: I enjoy celebrating the anniversaries and other milestones of my relationship.
items.zh: 我喜歡慶祝關係的週年紀念日和其他里程碑。

stories.name: Science Story
stories.description: Logical and analytical approach to love
stories.descriptionZh: 以邏輯和分析的方式看待愛情

items.en: I believe that the best relationships are those that can be analyzed in an objective way.
items.zh: 我相信最好的關係是那些可以客觀分析的關係。

items.en: I like to approach my relationship in a logical and analytical way.
items.zh: 我喜歡以邏輯和分析的方式處理我的關係。

items.en: I believe relationships work best when approached in a scientific way.
items.zh: 我相信當以科學方式處理時，關係效果最好。

items.en: I believe that the best way to solve relationship problems is through logical analysis.
items.zh: 我相信解決關係問題的最好方法是透過邏輯分析。

items.en: I like to analyze my relationship objectively.
items.zh: 我喜歡客觀地分析我的關係。

items.en: I believe couples should approach their relationship analytically.
items.zh: 我相信情侶應該以分析的方式處理他們的關係。

items.en: I believe in approaching relationships in a logical fashion.
items.zh: 我相信以邏輯方式處理關係。

items.en: I believe in solving relationship problems through rational analysis.
items.zh: 我相信透過理性分析解決關係問題。

stories.name: Cookbook Story
stories.description: Following a recipe for relationship success

items.en: I believe there is a right way and a wrong way of approaching close relationships. You can succeed if you know the right way.
items.zh: 我相信處理親密關係有對的方式和錯的方式。如果你知道正確的方式，你就能成功。

items.en: I believe that to have a good relationship you need to follow all the necessary steps one by one.
items.zh: 我相信要有好的關係，你需要一步一步遵循所有必要的步驟。

items.en: I believe the recipe for a great relationship is like the recipe for a great dish; it requires the right ingredients and attention to details.
items.zh: 我相信好關係的配方就像好菜的配方；它需要正確的材料和對細節的關注。

items.en: I believe that those who have succeeded in their relationships are those who have discovered what it takes to do them just right.
items.zh: 我相信那些在關係中成功的人是那些發現如何正確做到的人。

items.en: I believe that being successful in one's close relationship is like being able to cook well; using too much or too little of the necessary ingredients may prove disastrous.
items.zh: 我相信在親密關係中成功就像能夠做好菜一樣；使用太多或太少必要的材料可能會造成災難。

items.en: I believe a good relationship must follow certain steps to success.
items.zh: 我相信好的關係必須遵循某些成功的步驟。

items.en: I believe making a relationship work is much like following a recipe for success in cooking.
items.zh: 我相信讓關係運作很像遵循烹飪成功的配方。

items.en: I believe there is a recipe for success in relationships that some people find and others don't.
items.zh: 我相信關係成功有一個配方，有些人找到了，有些人沒有。

items.en: I think arguing is healthy for a close relationship.
items.zh: 我認為爭吵對親密關係是健康的。

items.en: I think fights actually make a relationship more vital.
items.zh: 我認為爭吵實際上使關係更有活力。

items.en: I think relationships in which partners do not have frequent arguments are dead.
items.zh: 我認為伴侶不經常爭吵的關係是死氣沉沉的。

items.en: I think it is more interesting to argue than to compromise.
items.zh: 我認為爭論比妥協更有趣。

items.en: I think frequent arguments help bring conflictive issues into the open and keep the relationship healthy.
items.zh: 我認為頻繁的爭論有助於將衝突問題公開化並保持關係健康。

items.en: I enjoy battling a lot with my partner to keep things interesting.
items.zh: 我喜歡與伴侶大量爭鬥以保持事情有趣。

items.en: Relationships involve a great deal of conflict, which I believe is actually good for the relationship.
items.zh: 關係涉及大量衝突，我認為這實際上對關係有益。

items.en: I actually like to fight with my partner.
items.zh: 我其實喜歡和伴侶吵架。

items.en: I think my relationships are like plays; some are comedies, some are dramas.
items.zh: 我認為我的關係就像戲劇；有些是喜劇，有些是戲劇。

items.en: I frequently put on an act for my partner.
items.zh: 我經常為伴侶表演。

items.en: I often find myself playing a role in my relationship, just like in a play.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己在關係中扮演一個角色，就像在戲劇中一樣。

items.en: I think of my relationship as acting in a play, except that I create my own unique surprise ending.
items.zh: 我把我的關係想成在戲劇中表演，除了我創造自己獨特的驚喜結局。

items.en: I often find myself attracted to partners who are able to play different roles, like actors in a play.
items.zh: 我經常發現自己被能扮演不同角色的伴侶吸引，就像戲劇中的演員一樣。

items.en: I like partners who can play different roles from one minute to the next.
items.zh: 我喜歡能從一分鐘到下一分鐘扮演不同角色的伴侶。

items.en: I like partners who have a sense of drama about themselves, like actors in a play.
items.zh: 我喜歡有戲劇感的伴侶，就像戲劇中的演員一樣。

items.en: I enjoy dating partners who are able to change their behavior according to the occasion, just like actors in a play.
items.zh: 我喜歡約會能根據場合改變行為的伴侶，就像戲劇中的演員一樣。

items.en: I like a partner who is willing to think about the funny side of our conflicts.
items.zh: 我喜歡願意思考我們衝突有趣一面的伴侶。

items.en: I like partners who are able occasionally to see the humorous side of issues.
items.zh: 我喜歡偶爾能看到問題幽默一面的伴侶。

items.en: I think taking a relationship too seriously can spoil it; that's why I like partners who have a sense of humor.
items.zh: 我認為太認真對待關係會破壞它；這就是為什麼我喜歡有幽默感的伴侶。

items.en: I like a partner who makes me laugh whenever we are facing a tense situation in our relationship.
items.zh: 我喜歡在我們關係中面臨緊張情況時能讓我笑的伴侶。

items.en: I admit that I sometimes try to use humor in order to avoid facing a problem in my relationship.
items.zh: 我承認我有時試圖用幽默來避免面對關係中的問題。

items.en: Often I like to joke around when my partner is upset with me, mainly because I think it is healing to be able to laugh at yourself even when you are facing a difficult situation in your relationship.
items.zh: 當伴侶對我不滿時，我經常喜歡開玩笑，主要是因為我認為即使在關係中面臨困難時能夠自嘲是有療癒作用的。

items.en: I like to use humor when I have a conflict with my partner because I believe there is always a humorous side to any conflict situation in relationships.
items.zh: 當我與伴侶發生衝突時，我喜歡使用幽默，因為我相信關係中任何衝突情況都有幽默的一面。

items.en: When I disagree with my partner, I often try to make a joke out of it.
items.zh: 當我不同意伴侶時，我經常試圖把它變成笑話。

items.en: I am often attracted to individuals who have an air of mystery about them.
items.zh: 我經常被有神秘氣息的人吸引。

items.en: I like it when my partner is a bit hard to figure out.
items.zh: 我喜歡伴侶有點難以捉摸。

items.en: I often become attracted to individuals who are somewhat mysterious.
items.zh: 我經常被有些神秘的人吸引。

items.en: I find mysterious partners who have hidden secrets to be quite attractive.
items.zh: 我發現有隱藏秘密的神秘伴侶相當有吸引力。

items.en: I do not believe it is absolutely necessary to let my partner know a lot about me.
items.zh: 我不認為讓伴侶非常了解我是絕對必要的。

items.en: I like to create a sense of mystery about myself in my close relationships.
items.zh: 我喜歡在親密關係中創造關於自己的神秘感。

items.en: I keep lots of secrets from my partner in my relationship and I like it that way.
items.zh: 我在關係中對伴侶保守很多秘密，我喜歡這樣。

items.en: I believe it is good to keep your partner guessing about yourself in a relationship.
items.zh: 我相信在關係中讓伴侶對你保持猜測是好的。
